schematic_note: Features flagged schematic:true pair a wharf sheet's SCHEMATIC east-side block outline with a downtown sheet's surveyed drawing. The locate agents measured corner disagreements up to ~100 px BETWEEN THE DRAWINGS themselves on these pairs. Such features measure source disagreement, not registration error — exclude them from any pass/fail alignment gate; the surveyed downtown drawing is authoritative there.
redraw_scatter_note: Every boundary measured shows hand-drawn disagreement between the two sheets' redraws of the shared strip: ~24 px total scatter on the best pair (12|14) up to ~50-70 px on 11|13 and 41|39, ~30 px internal drift on wharf pair 07|06, and up to ~100 px on the schematic Avenue A pairs. Judge per-landmark steps against this source scatter — a registration cannot beat the drawings' own agreement.
junction_note: junction-* features are street-FURNITURE correspondences at the Avenue A crossing (pipes, dashed rows). Unlike the schematic block corners they represent what the eye follows across the wharf/downtown seam, so they carry real weight in the repair solve. The 23rd and 24th crossings were measured but the two sheets' dashed rows could not be matched consistently; no feature was invented.
